headline: Hitech Corporation files mandatory insider trading disclosure
hook: Insider trading disclosure filed by Hitech Corporation
summary: Hitech Corporation Limited has submitted a disclosure to the NSE under Regulation 7(2) of the SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015. This regulation requires listed companies to report changes in shareholding by promoters, directors, and designated employees. Such filings are routine compliance procedures for listed entities. Retail investors should note this is a standard regulatory update rather than a material business event.
why_it_matters: Routine regulatory filing with no immediate impact on share price.
